method: For every source page, preserve rune lines and run five orders: rows, whole reverse, alternate-row reversal, ordinal columns, ordinal columns reverse. Apply the exact source suite: direct, Atbash, 28 nonzero shifts, prime/prime-minus-one/totient streams each in two signs, and repeating DIVINITY subtraction; whole-page source GP transliteration quadgram score.
scope: Source segmentation: 55 unsolved rune-bearing segments 0..54 = current LP2-00..49 and LP2-51..55; source segments 55,56 = solved LP2-56,57. Blank LP2-50 is not a source segment. Every rune of each page, headings included.
source_result_parity: Compare the exact source best_all, best_unsolved and per_order_best with archived source result; three-decimal source rounding.
positive_controls: Score both known-reading tail pages in direct row order; LP2-56 is itself enciphered, so only the direct LP2-57 Parable is required to exceed -5.0.
Encrypt one solved page by plus-seven then reverse odd lines; boustrophedon plus shift7 must restore it exactly and exceed -5.0.
A second planted source page is permuted by inverse ordinal-column order then shifted; colmajor route plus shift7 must recover the same solved page.

null_control.rule: 49 independent within-page rune shuffles of the 55 unsolved source segments; preserve each line length and page boundary, repeat the entire five-route×37-cipher search; compare one global best over all settings per shuffle.
null_control.rng: Python 3.12 random.Random(seed), flatten each source page, shuffle its complete rune vector, then restore original line lengths in source page order; one global RNG shared across all 49 controls

limits: This exact archive evaluates deterministic reading-order plus specific simple ciphers with one English model. No arbitrary paths, page concatenation, alternate keys, non-English recognition or hidden text. A null control preserves page symbols and line lengths but is not an encryption model. Original source did not use these 49 added shuffles; clearly separate archived score from added controls.
